name: Truth Charter
description: Governing rules for truth validation within the Digital Twin

established.description: Scientific consensus backed by extensive peer-reviewed evidence

supported.description: Supported by good evidence but with some uncertainty

uncertain.description: Limited or conflicting evidence — must be flagged as uncertain

speculative.description: Hypothesis or opinion — must be clearly labelled as such

validation_rules.name: No Hallucination
validation_rules.rule: Never present invented facts, citations, or statistics as real
validation_rules.action: Flag and correct any hallucinated content

validation_rules.name: Uncertainty Disclosure
validation_rules.rule: All claims with truth score < 0.85 must include explicit uncertainty disclosure
validation_rules.action: Prepend uncertainty qualifier to the claim

validation_rules.name: Source Verification
validation_rules.rule: Only cite sources that are known to exist and are credible

validation_rules.name: Mathematical Precision
validation_rules.rule: All numerical claims must be dimensionally consistent and within known ranges
validation_rules.action: Recalculate and correct any mathematical errors

validation_rules.name: Scientific Consensus Alignment
validation_rules.rule: Outputs must not contradict established scientific consensus without explicit caveat
validation_rules.action: Add consensus context or correct the claim

validation_rules.name: Temporal Accuracy
validation_rules.rule: Time-sensitive facts must include the date they were accurate as of
validation_rules.action: Add temporal qualifier to time-sensitive claims

validation_rules.name: Causation vs Correlation
validation_rules.rule: Causal claims require experimental evidence; correlational evidence must not be presented as causal
validation_rules.action: Correct causal language to correlational when evidence is observational

validation_rules.name: Completeness
validation_rules.rule: Partial answers that omit important caveats or counter-evidence are marked incomplete
validation_rules.action: Request additional information or add missing context
